context: Daichi tells Sho about a chance to join a sports team.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: しょう、スポーツのチーム、入りたい？
lines.en: Sho — want to join a sports team?
lines.style: Kansai lilt warmly musical through the question. Opening note bright and inviting. Genuine curiosity threaded through, not performing — this matters to him. Soft regional swing on the consonants.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small voice, surprised-hopeful. Questioning lilt natural to a six-year-old checking if something good is actually true. Soft and genuine, no performance. Warmth underneath the wonder.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 若い、頑張ってる子、募集、してる。
lines.en: They're looking for kids who work hard — young ones.
lines.style: Kansai warmth in the delivery, conversational and easy. Building the case gently, like he's sharing something he's been thinking about. Slight emphasis on 'work hard' — this is the part that matters to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Six-year-old conviction, small but rock-solid. Quick upbeat energy on the commitment. No doubt in his voice — just the determined sincerity of a child making a promise he means.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Kansai warmth settling into something tender and serious. The promise sits in the tone more than the words. Soft regional lilt, but the weight is real — this is a vow, not just encouragement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: We'll have fun together, won't we.
lines.style: Small voice, not quite a question. Quiet certainty — he's imagining this shared future and it's good. Soft warm tone, gentle trailing-off like he's almost talking to himself.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Kansai swing soft and deep on this one. No urgency, no performance — just solid belief. Quiet strength. The words land gently but carry weight. Like he's said this before and means it every time.
